sourceDesc.bibl: Sourced from the online version of Greenough's (1900) edition on Perseus Digital Library; accessed online [http://www.perseus.tufts.edu/hopper/text?doc=Perseus%3atext%3a1999.02.0055]

projectDesc.p: Digital files compiled for doctoral thesis at the University of Oxford; 'Equivalency, Page Design, and the Digital Humanities: An Interdisciplinary Approach to Gavin Douglas’s Eneados'; by Megan Bushnell

correction.p: The spelling and punctuation and content of these files has been altered to match that of Ascensius's (1501) ediiton. For the most part these changes are rather minor. However, in some cases words and whole lines have been altered. These changes have not been highlighted in the text.

punctuation.p: Punctuation changed to match that of Ascensius's (1501) edition.

segmentation.p: (div type="book") indicates book divisions in the 'Eneados'; each (div) is numbered and given a unique identifier; these identifiers are formatted to include text name and book number in Roman numerals (AenI).

(div type="chapter") indicates chapter divisions in the 'Eneados'; each (div) is numbered based on the number of chapters overall and given a unique identifier with reference to the book it occurs in; these identifiers are formatted to include text name, book number in Roman numerals, and chapter number in Arabic numerals (AenI.1).

(div type="section") indicates section divisions in the 'Aeneid'; each (div) is numbered based on the number of sections overall and given a unique identifier with reference to the book and chapter it occurs in; these identifiers are formatted to include text name, book number in Roman numerals, chapter number in Arabic numerals, and section letter (AenI.1.a).
(said) indicates sections of speech and reported speech; these are specified by author and author attributes (gender, status, and nation).
(ab) indicates translation units; these are numbered and can be matched to the same number in the Latin files to find equivalent material.

(l) indicates a line and is given a unique identifier formatted to include book number in Roman numerals, chapter number, and line number; couplet lines within a rubric have no line number, but are labelled as 'a' and 'b'.

interpretation.p: The segmentation of the text into translation units is an original contribution and has not been externally vetted.
The segmentation of narrative, speech, and reported speech is an original contribution and has not been externally vetted.
